newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer - unclear what reserves ECB will get.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer - unclear what reserves ECB will get.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that it was still unclear what reserves national central banks will transfer to the planned European Central Bank (ECB).
"Whether gold will be transferred and if yes, to what extent, is still completely open," Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer also reiterated Germany's opposition to gold sales by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and that neither the German government nor the Bundesbank planned gold sales.
"The Bundesbank and the Bonn government both agree that gold sales will not take place," Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer was speaking at a news conference following a regular policy-setting council meeting.
Tietmeyer also said that reserves not transferred to the ECB will be retained by national central banks.
